description: Distinct Pixel 10a (stallion) Android 17 distribution gates for issue #399. Each gate is recorded separately: one gate's evidence never satisfies another, and development evidence never makes a gate passed. Statuses are 'not run', 'development', 'failed' or 'passed'; 'passed' needs at least one release-level evidence entry. Statuses are recorded from executed builds, boots, drills and user sessions, never by software. scripts/aosp-pixel10a.mjs pixel10aGateProblems checks this file against the source lock, product descriptor and update channel.

sourceAdmission.requirement: Exact Pixel 10a SKU/codename and platform, kernel, vendor and firmware source and hash lock admitted for release.

evidence.summary: Admitted lock 760a7184 verified on 2026-10-26 UTC against the retained source and factory archive: 1,087 project revisions, 16 overrides, 6,360 generated vendor files, factory SHA-256, plus the exactly applied listening-chip patch.

sourceAdmission.scope: Source inputs only. Not an image build, boot, signing or device result.

apkVariants.requirement: Standalone and launcher, debug and release variants build and pass package verification, independently of image qualification.

evidence.summary: Alpha 3f25885d / Eliza f931082e: standalone and launcher, debug and unsigned release, verified by verify-apks with the packaged Cloud runtime.

apkVariants.scope: Build and package contents only. Release APK signing (decision A-06) and installation are not part of this gate.

cuttlefishBoot.requirement: A Cuttlefish image built from the release candidate boots and passes scripts/verify-cuttlefish-launcher.mjs (system Alpha APK, Alpha HOME, recovery HOME, enforcing SELinux).

evidence.summary: Read-only: a development CP2A.260605.016 userdebug test-keys alpha_cf_x86_64_phone image (Android 17) booted with enforcing SELinux, but Alpha runs from a /data/app override, so the launcher postboot verifier cannot pass.

cuttlefishBoot.scope: Image integration on the virtual target. Not physical hardware.

physicalDevice.requirement: The release image on a physical Pixel 10a completes the per-unit checks in docs/pilot-acceptance-runbook.md (Execute on every unit, Performance and stability).

evidence.summary: October 19 unlocked, development-signed Cloud image at Alpha e240ddab: archive admission, flash and initial boot only.

physicalDevice.scope: Device functions only. Not update, recovery or user acceptance.

signedUpdateRecovery.requirement: Release-signed image and OTA with every update and recovery drill in android/aosp/pixel10a-ota-channel.json passed.
signedUpdateRecovery.scope: Mirrors the channel drill record; it cannot pass while any channel drill or the known-good release is unset.

userAcceptance.requirement: Pilot users accept the release on physical Pixel 10a devices following docs/pilot-acceptance-runbook.md.
userAcceptance.scope: User acceptance only. It follows, and does not replace, every other gate.
